examples.title: Country picker
examples.description: Enable `countrySelector` for the anchored searchable list. The number remains national digits; the country selection never formats or rewrites it.

examples.title: Fixed country
examples.description: Keep a known country fixed with `countryIso`, `countryCode` and `showChevron={false}`. Existing v1 defaults and props still work.

examples.title: Preferred countries
examples.description: Pin ISO codes with `preferredCountries`; the remaining choices follow alphabetically. Search matches names, ISO codes and calling codes.

examples.title: Custom country list
examples.description: Pass `countries` to restrict or extend the choices. Each entry carries `iso`, `name` and `dialCode`; this list does not perform number validation.

examples.title: Keyboard
examples.description: Open with Enter, Space or the arrow keys. Arrows, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End move through results; Enter picks and focuses the number, Escape returns to the country button.

examples.title: Digit limit
examples.description: `phoneMaxNumber` takes precedence over `maxLength` and counts sanitized digits. The field does not assume every country has the same number length.

examples.title: Formatted national paste
examples.description: Try pasting `98765 43210`. Separators are removed before the ten-digit limit; selected digits are replaced and the remaining suffix is preserved. Full international numbers starting with + stay rejected; supply national digits.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: `disabled` prevents typing and country selection. The gray surface keeps the same 44px field height.

examples.title: Read only
examples.description: In built-in picker mode `readOnly` locks both the country and number. For compatibility, legacy callback mode continues to apply read-only behavior to the number alone.

examples.title: Custom flag
examples.description: `countryFlag` replaces the default SVG flag. Keep its display in sync with the selected country when combining it with a picker.

examples.title: Controlled country and number
examples.description: `countryIso` controls selection and `onCountryChange` receives `{ iso, name, dialCode }`. The original `value` and `onChange` still carry national digits.

examples.title: Validation
examples.description: `validation` displays an associated error message; `aria-invalid={true}` also applies the red border. Validation is supplied by your form, not inferred from the country.

examples.title: Existing country callback
examples.description: The default remains callback mode: `onCountryClick` opens your own chooser. This inline chooser demonstrates the old contract without a modal.

examples.title: Native form submission
examples.description: `name` submits the same national digits as v1. If your app needs the calling code, keep it separately; this form adds its own hidden field.

examples.title: Inside a dialog
examples.description: The country list is anchored to the field and escapes clipping. Search and scrolling remain usable inside a dialog; Escape closes the country list before the dialog.
